use_case_summary: WishFox is a creator workflow tool that lets authenticated users schedule and publish short-form clips to their own YouTube channels via OAuth. Each user links their channel once; uploads are initiated only by the channel owner. The app applies metadata, optional thumbnails, and pinned comments. API usage is dominated by videos.insert (~1600 units per upload) plus occasional channels.list and thumbnails.set calls.
quota_justification: We serve multi-channel creators who batch-schedule 50-100+ clips per day per workspace. Target capacity is 800 uploads/day across our user base at launch scale. Default 10,000 units/day supports ~6 uploads per GCP project; we request 200,000 units/day per project (~125 uploads/day) to provide headroom, fault isolation across OAuth clients, and stay within YouTube API Services Terms while we scale verified production users.
